finding: c-define and function converters emit void, SCMOBJ and typed SFUN variants; argument/result conversions and generated release wrappers surround calls; errors may retry
hazard: End of successful Scheme call is before result conversion, error retry, marker clear and propagation
proposedReplacement: Generate effect/exit descriptors and explicit off-stack close guard for every variant; close after last managed effect, not after SFUN_CALL

finding: c-lambda emits inline/out-of-line context, optional cleanup TRY, user text or function, AT_END and result publication
hazard: Arbitrary C text can return/longjmp/spawn or retain aliases; AT_END does not wrap every escape
proposedReplacement: Managed raw C effect declaration plus admitted endpoint protocol, otherwise reject controlled cohort; preserve user Scheme semantics separately

finding: make_vector allocates/fills before marker procedure/processor body writes; proc root TODO
hazard: Publishing seal at allocation return omits later body writes; local proc may lack root across allocation
proposedReplacement: Root proc before allocating; typed safe marker shell/initialization transaction and issuer after body/result publication

finding: kill clears vector0 then decrements raw still refcount
hazard: Seal before kill misses both writes; repeated cleanup may decrement twice
proposedReplacement: Move physical marker retirement into canonical guarded effect; exactly-once decision not a second scalar authority

finding: Conversion handler and return-to-C inspect marker procedure/processor; generated C retains raw access
hazard: Scheme-only generator change leaves old generated readers and raw vector alias interpretation
proposedReplacement: Regenerate admitted modules; typed marker operations and fixed subtype/profile manifest; legacy module gated out of controlled cohort

finding: ___call matching return restores frame; nonmatching throws; ___run TRY can escape before normal kill
hazard: Normal END and C local guard do not cover every nonlocal exit or nested activation
proposedReplacement: Off-stack guard owns original identity/root/initialization duty; nested guard closes itself; preserve Scheme continuation return rights

finding: Allocator links next/head before count/length/header and caller-filled body; release decrements
hazard: Generic allocation end cannot certify caller initialization or helper/link stores
proposedReplacement: VM controlled domain preserves intent, shape and writer lineage; per-operation construction close distinct from whole domain scan close

finding: RC sentinel per PSTATE, register links four fields, set_data writes payload, release unlinks/frees; closure producer fills root
hazard: Copying sentinel pointer to VM leaves PSTATE dependency; P0-only mark_rc branch does not scan transferred nonzero roots
proposedReplacement: Canonical VM root domain with physical relink and all-domain scan admission; RC and still accounting remain distinct

finding: Setup marks; sweep rewrites links/counters, free_still clears head and invokes foreign release functions
hazard: Cleanup itself writes and may call foreign producer after an earlier data seal
proposedReplacement: Phase-authorized cleanup cohort and finalizer effect profile; transfer task/root/native resource before original domain seal

finding: Procedural interrupt enqueue takes target mutex; cleanup invokes execute_fn(intr,false) under that mutex, then clears head/tail before mem cleanup
hazard: An unclosed enqueue producer can race cleanup; cleanup interrupt release is outside SFUN generator coverage
proposedReplacement: Close external interrupt admission; transfer callback debt under queue lock then invoke admitted callback outside locks or reject reentrant handler; pin target incarnation

finding: Shrink child cleanup then thread_exit; P0 join ignores return; grow setup failure cleans attempted states
hazard: Join happens after destructive cleanup; rollback is a separate cleanup caller, not evidence of initialized cohort
proposedReplacement: VM acceptance + detach/closure preflight common to shrink and partially initialized rollback; source bug speculation is outside this study

finding: cleanup disables global interrupts, shrinks and calls cleanup_pstate; cleanup exported through GSTATE
hazard: Patching resize alone leaves direct shutdown/exported cleanup capable of destroying backing
proposedReplacement: Single cleanup admission service for every call route; distinguish no-publication rollback from live-cohort handoff

finding: Starter invokes start_fn; join converts nonzero pthread return via errno; thread_set_pstate sets TLS/affinity
hazard: Failed/unknown join is no stop proof; data closure alone does not authorize reclaim of TLS/native envelope
proposedReplacement: Preserve raw return/incarnation/single join owner; retain envelope until known termination and native readers drain

finding: PSTATE OS cleanup closes select-abort handle; VM cleanup destroys memory/scan locks then P0 memory cleanup
hazard: VM-owned pointer can still depend on OS handle, scan lock or root storage being destroyed
proposedReplacement: Audit physical dependency graph and GC view before receipt; VM shutdown must drain service before its shared infrastructure

finding: Function-valued callbacks use RC payload and current closure self; native libraries own callback/delete timing
hazard: Helper/callback capability can outlive parent; global closure self/TLS TODO and raw aliases defeat local closure proof
proposedReplacement: Register before native publication; foreign unregister/drain receipt, explicit closure identity/root/code lease; reject unbounded raw origins

finding: GSTATE exposes marker/thread functions; emulated CAS takes hashed mutex; selected recovery helper is proposed, absent current source
hazard: Unregistered helper or abandoned backend lock invalidates closure; symbol search cannot prove all loaded C aliases
proposedReplacement: Typed helper admission before enqueue/effect; complete module/effect manifest; unknown holder keeps duty and blocks dependent GC domain
